## Mackit 1.0.2
The About section now points at the official website and the GitHub repository.
- **About links**: the website entry opens the official site (<https://www.mingcui.cn/mackit/>), and a new GitHub repository link (<https://github.com/virskor/mackit>) sits beside it. Both labels are localized in Simplified Chinese, English and Traditional Chinese. - **Universal binary**: one download covers both Apple silicon (arm64) and Intel (x86_64) Macs, macOS 14 or later. - **Signed and notarized**: Developer ID signature with the notarization ticket stapled — double-click to install, no Gatekeeper warning. - **In-app updates**: 1.0.x users get this release through Sparkle, no browser re-download needed.
### Under the hood
- `AGENTS.md` records the contributor workflow: build and test commands, code conventions, and the English-first rule for development artifacts. - `docs/RELEASE.md` documents the GitHub Releases hosting layout (the four assets every release must carry, and why `MACKIT_DOWNLOAD_URL_PREFIX` must point at the release's own tag).

## Mackit 1.0.1
发布链路验证版：签名、公证、DMG 安装与应用内自动更新的首次全流程实测。
- 更新源切换为 GitHub Releases 托管（`https://github.com/virskor/mackit/releases/latest/download/appcast.xml`），仓库公开后匿名即可拉取 - 更新归档与 appcast 随每个 Release 一同发布，1.0.0 用户可在应用内直接升级到 1.0.1 - Developer ID 签名 + 公证 + 装订均通过，下载后双击即可安装 - 文档补充维护者向的发布托管说明（`docs/RELEASE.md`）

## Mackit 1.0.0
首个正式版。
- **缓存扫描**：一键扫描 50+ 类开发缓存（Go / Node / Flutter / Rust / Python / CocoaPods / Xcode / Gradle 等），流式出结果，逐项勾选后清理，每项标注风险等级 - **应用卸载**：列出已安装应用及其在 `~/Library` 的残留文件，可连同残留一起卸载，正在运行的应用会拒绝卸载 - **项目构建产物**：扫描自定义目录下的 `node_modules`、`build`、`Pods`、`DerivedData`、`target`、`.venv` 等可重建目录 - **菜单栏面板**：CPU / 内存 / 温度监控、内存占用排行与一键释放、磁盘可用空间 - **多语言**：简体中文 / 英语 / 繁体中文，跟随系统语言
